text:
Maya Park: Quick heads-up — please join me in welcoming Jordan Kim, who starts today as Senior Product Manager, Platform. Jordan will be owning the runtime product roadmap (autoscaling, cache policies, rollout primitives) and will work closely with Eng-Platform and Eng-ML. Jordan is remote (EST) and their first week will be focused on onboarding and meeting key partners. :tada:

Jordan Kim: Hi everyone — really excited to be here! Thanks Maya. Looking forward to meeting folks and getting up to speed. Happy to pair on handoffs for any open items.

Samir Gupta: Welcome Jordan — huge win for the platform team. I’ll book a 30-min sync for next week to go over priorities and key SLAs. Quick Q for Maya/@Anita: is there a delegated owner for the Priya backlog items until Jordan ramps?

Maya Park: @Samir good question — Ben will be the interim owner for urgent Priya items (routing, deployment policy) until Jordan takes them over. We’ll update the roadmap doc and handoff checklist later today.

Ben Ortiz: Yep, I’ll take point on critical incidents and any pending deployment PRs. Jordan — once you’re in, I’ll send over the audit notes and the current rollout playbook.

Jordan Kim: @Ben perfect, thanks. Could you drop the playbook link here when you have a minute? Also tagging @onboarding-bot for access requests.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Jordan! To get started please run:
```
/link-workspace onboard add_user jordan.kim@redwood.com
/link-groups add_to group:platform-engineering jordan.kim@redwood.com
```
Then fill the 1-week checklist at https://internal.redwood.onboarding/checklists/jordan-kim.

Anita Rao: Hi Jordan — I’m your onboarding partner. I’ll send calendar invites for Benefits 101, Security & Compliance kickoff, and group intros. Also FYI there’s one open PM role on the Platform squad we’re still actively hiring for; if you have strong referrals please DM me.

Samir Gupta: One more note — Jordan will sit in Eng-Platform org but will have a dotted line to Product for roadmap decisions. Plan is to ramp through Q2 and start driving the autoscaling/kv-cache initiative. Excited to have you. :rocket:

Jordan Kim: Thanks all — looking forward to diving in. I’ll start with the onboarding checklist and reach out to Ben and Samir for synchs. :)
